used_propositions: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM, while invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited, and those name forms refer to the same legal entity.
Billing records show the billed name Helion Robotics Limited.
Master services agreement MSA-HELION-2019 lists Counterparty: Helion Robotics Ltd.
support_claim: The MSA counterparty Helion Robotics Ltd and the billing name Helion Robotics Limited are explicitly established as the same legal entity, so billing:Helion Robotics Limited and contract:MSA-HELION-2019 denote one counterparty.
